previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted from a skilled nursing facility due to positive blood cultures growing Staphylococcus, likely from a tunnel site infection of her tunneled dialysis catheter. She was asymptomatic but treated with intravenous vancomycin. The infected catheter was removed and a new left internal jugular tunneled dialysis line was placed. Repeat blood cultures remained negative, and a transthoracic echocardiogram showed no evidence of endocarditis. She completed a full course of antibiotics with dialysis and was monitored for wound care related to calciphylaxis, with no surgical intervention needed. She experienced mild musculoskeletal chest pain, which was evaluated and deemed non-cardiac. The patient was discharged to an extended care facility to complete her antibiotic course with ongoing dialysis and wound management.
